english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for encouraging someone or cheering a team on; use 安慰 for plain consolation and 氹 for cheering someone up.
Use this colloquial choice when cheering someone on or giving them emotional support.

examples.english: We cheer for our teammates together.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 tung4 deoi6 jau5 daa2 hei3

examples.english: We’ll go to the venue to encourage you.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jin6 coeng4 tung4 nei5 daa2 hei3

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when putting air into a balloon, tyre, or other object.

examples.english: The balloon is leaking air, so I need to inflate it again before my daughter can play with it.
examples.traditional: 個氣球漏氣，我要再打氣先可以畀個女玩。
examples.jyutping: go3 hei3 kau4 lau6 hei3 ngo5 jiu3 zoi3 daa2 hei3 sin1 ho2 ji5 bei2 go3 neoi2 waan2
